messages.subject: Closing R session leads to empty plots / files
messages.subject_clean: Closing R session leads to empty plots / files
messages.body_plain: I'm not sure whether this issue is specific to vim-R-plugin, but I think it might. I have in more recent time come across a frustrating issue. Say I have a code and R session open in tmux. I produce a plot. I then close the R session. Sometimes (but not always), the file then becomes empty, or if the plot was split into multiple panels, all but the first would become empty. I then have to reopen the session, re-create the plot, and hope for the best. Do you have any idea why this might be happening, or what I might be doing wrong?

messages.subject: Re: Closing R session leads to empty plots / files
messages.subject_clean: Closing R session leads to empty plots / files
messages.body_plain:
If you're plotting to a file (PDF, PNG, etc), then you have to use the command dev.off() to tell R that the plot is finished, otherwise R will keep waiting for drawing commands, like in the example below:

pdf("example.pdf")
plot(rnorm(100), rnorm(100))
lines(c(-1,1), c(-1,1))
dev.off()

Does your code include a call to dev.off() after each plot is finished? R itself calls dev.off() when you quits it, but the Vim-R-plugin kills the Tmux pane where R is. So, without dev.off() R might be killed before having time to write the file. I guess that this is what's happening.

messages.body_plain:

If you follow the given answers then you can fix runtime error r6034. If you need more help then visit the given link:
http://www.removewindowserror.com
